newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar hits 33-month high of 112.55 yen in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Dollar hits 33-month high of 112.55 yen in Tokyo.

text.p: The dollar rose to a 33-month high of 112.55 yen in late Tokyo trade, propelled higher by heavy buying of marks for yen and the triggering of stop-loss buying, traders said.
The mark buying was apparently from overseas fund operators, and as the mark rose against the yen it took the dollar with it, setting off stop-loss buying at around 112.30-40 yen, they added.
It was the dollar's highest level since January 1994.
